items.author: BitcoinMagazine
items.context: Bitcoin Magazine (BitcoinMagazine): James Lavish (cofundador de Bitcoin Opportunity Fund) dice que, según el power law, el caso base para Bitcoin es $400.000–$500.000 en 2029: «Bitcoin typically stays within one standard deviation of the mean... one standard deviation over that mean in 2029 is $400K—$500K» (con video).
items.suggested_text: Worth noting that $400-500K is the +1 std dev band, not the trend line itself, and the model has spent long stretches below its mean too. A useful map, not a promise. I laid out my own read of the power law to 2050 here: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119169301949141264

items.author: MarioNawfal
items.context: Mario Nawfal: el CEO de Ledger, Pascal Gauthier, predice que «Everybody will be hacked at some point» y advierte que la IA vuelve los ciberataques más rápidos y sofisticados.
items.suggested_text: If the hardware wallet CEO says everyone gets hacked eventually, the takeaway isn't panic, it's fewer points of failure: no exchange, no vendor firmware you can't audit, keys that never touch an online device. I wrote a book on building that air-gapped $BTC setup yourself, free on Kindle until Wednesday: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: BSCNWire
items.context: BSCN Newswire: dice que grandes holders de $BTC están dejando la autocustodia por el ETF IBIT de BlackRock a ritmo récord; el video explica la razón que citan y por qué los flujos diarios cuentan otra historia.
items.suggested_text: Convenience is real, but moving into an ETF means trading keys for a claim on someone else's custody. Fine for some, but it's worth knowing exactly what you give up. For anyone going the other way, I wrote a guide to building your own air-gapped $BTC setup, free on Kindle until Wednesday: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: Truecrypto
items.context: Mr. Anderson (Truecrypto): si los grandes compradores esperaban valor en Bitcoin, este sería el lugar para aparecer; reconoce que la acción del precio ha sido «god-awful» y que ha advertido no dar por hecho que los alcistas recuperaron el control hasta que reclamen un nivel previo.
items.suggested_text: Agree that a reclaim matters more than a bounce. The tell for me would be $BTC holding the reclaimed level on a daily close, not just tagging it. Are you watching spot volume or flows to confirm the big buyers actually showed up?
